> Illustrative business case. Effect sizes labelled 'VERITRAIL hypothesis — validate in pilot' have not been measured with customers. Results are estimates, not guaranteed savings, and are not financial advice. Risk-reduction value is an expected-value estimate, not a prediction that incidents will or will not occur.

Currency: USD. All values per year unless stated.

## Summary

| Measure | Value |
|---|---|
| Gross modelled annual benefit | 160,980 |
| Year-1 realized benefit | 120,735 |
| Year-1 cost | 105,000 |
| Year-1 net benefit | 15,735 |
| Year-1 ROI | 15.0% |
| Steady-state annual net benefit | 85,980 |

**Assessment:** AI Governance Maturity Self-Assessment (template VERITRAIL-SA-MATURITY v1.0.0)

> This self-assessment produces an indicative, self-reported view of AI governance maturity. All results are User-asserted: no evidence has been reviewed. Framework readiness indicators are not a determination of conformity with ISO/IEC 42001, compliance with the EU AI Act, or alignment with NIST AI RMF. VERITRAIL does not certify compliance and this report is not legal advice.

## 1. Overall maturity

Scoring: domain score = sum of answers ÷ maximum possible × 100; overall = Σ(domain score × weight). Source: VERITRAIL self-assessment template VERITRAIL-SA-MATURITY v1.0.0.

## 3. Top strengths

- No practices were rated 4 or 5. Strengths will emerge as foundational controls are implemented.

## 4. Top gaps

| # | Domain | Question | Answer | Recommended action | VERITRAIL controls |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | AI Inventory & Visibility | INV-Q1: Does your organization maintain a complete inventory of AI systems, models, agents, and vendor AI products? | 1/5 | Stand up an AI system of record and run inventory workshops plus shadow-AI discovery to reach full coverage. | EI-01, EI-08, EI-09 |
| 2 | AI Inventory & Visibility | INV-Q2: Are AI systems classified by business criticality, data sensitivity, decision impact, autonomy, and regulatory relevance? | 1/5 | Apply VERITRAIL risk-tier criteria to every inventory record and approve tier assignments. | EI-02 |
| 3 | AI Inventory & Visibility | INV-Q3: Can you identify the owner, purpose, users, data sources, and dependencies for each material AI system? | 1/5 | Complete owner, purpose, users, data-source and dependency fields for all material AI systems. | EI-03, EI-04, EI-06, EI-10 |
| 4 | Risk Management & Lifecycle | RSK-Q1: Do AI use cases undergo risk assessment before production deployment? | 1/5 | Make a tier-proportionate risk and impact assessment a mandatory gate before any production deployment. | GL-01, GL-02, GL-03 |
| 5 | Risk Management & Lifecycle | RSK-Q2: Are model, prompt, data, vendor, and agent changes subject to change control and reassessment? | 1/5 | Add AI-specific change triggers (model, prompt, data, vendor, tool, agent) to change management with reassessment rules. | GL-04, EI-05 |

## 5. Critical risk flags

- **Critical gap — No reliable AI inventory** (trigger: INV-Q1). Without a complete inventory, risk tiering, oversight and evidence cannot be applied to systems you do not know about. Controls: EI-01, EI-09. Evidence status: User-asserted.
- **Critical gap — AI deployed without pre-deployment risk assessment** (trigger: RSK-Q1). Systems reaching production without risk assessment may carry unidentified legal, safety or security exposure. Controls: GL-02, GL-03. Evidence status: User-asserted.
- **Critical gap — Sensitive data may reach prompts, logs or external models** (trigger: DAT-Q3). Unredacted personal or confidential data in prompts and logs creates privacy and confidentiality exposure. Controls: IS-04, IS-03. Evidence status: User-asserted.
- **Critical gap — Agents or LLM apps not tested for prompt injection and unsafe tool use** (trigger: SEC-Q2). Agents with tool access that are untested for injection can be manipulated into unauthorised actions or data leakage. Controls: IS-14, IS-11, IS-12. Evidence status: User-asserted.
- **Critical gap — No tested kill switch or rollback** (trigger: SEC-Q3). Without containment, an AI incident cannot be stopped quickly. Controls: IS-15. Evidence status: User-asserted.
- **Critical gap — High-impact decisions lack defined human oversight** (trigger: HUM-Q1). High-impact AI decisions without review, override or appeal raise fairness, safety and accountability exposure. Controls: IS-09, IS-13. Evidence status: User-asserted.
- **Critical gap — Cannot produce audit-ready evidence** (trigger: ASR-Q2). Inability to evidence controls undermines responses to auditors, customers and regulators. Controls: SE-05, SE-08. Evidence status: User-asserted.
- **Critical gap — EU-facing AI without consistent AI-interaction disclosure** (trigger: FST-Q2). Transparency obligations for certain AI systems (EU AI Act Art. 50) require readiness; legal review recommended. Controls: IS-08. Evidence status: User-asserted.
- **Critical gap — No AI governance policy or accountable owner** (trigger: STR-Q1). Without a policy and owner, no one is accountable for AI risk decisions. Controls: AO-01, AO-02. Evidence status: User-asserted.

## 6. 30/60/90-day action plan

### First 30 days — stabilise

- Stand up an AI system of record and run inventory workshops plus shadow-AI discovery to reach full coverage. (AI Inventory & Visibility; INV-Q1; controls EI-01, EI-08, EI-09)
- Apply VERITRAIL risk-tier criteria to every inventory record and approve tier assignments. (AI Inventory & Visibility; INV-Q2; controls EI-02)
- Complete owner, purpose, users, data-source and dependency fields for all material AI systems. (AI Inventory & Visibility; INV-Q3; controls EI-03, EI-04, EI-06, EI-10)
- Make a tier-proportionate risk and impact assessment a mandatory gate before any production deployment. (Risk Management & Lifecycle; RSK-Q1; controls GL-01, GL-02, GL-03)
- Add AI-specific change triggers (model, prompt, data, vendor, tool, agent) to change management with reassessment rules. (Risk Management & Lifecycle; RSK-Q2; controls GL-04, EI-05)

### Days 31–60 — standardise

- No actions in this horizon based on your answers.
